newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Vimpelcom to trade on RTS from Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Vimpelcom to trade on RTS from Tuesday.

text.p: Shares in mobile telecoms operator Vimpelcom (VympelKom in Russian) will trade on the Russian Trading System from Tuesday, an official at the national brokers' association NAUFOR said.

Vimpelcom, which operates a cellular network in the Moscow region, listed its shares in New York last November, the first Russian company to trade on Wall Street, but has so far not been traded on the RTS market.
